title: From Isolated Feature to Orbits: Discovering Music Concepts via Multi-SAE Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.01864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can we understand what a music foundation model has learned \textit{internally}? Most interpretability approaches, such as probing and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), focus on identifying individual features with minimal structural assumptions. We argue that many concepts are better understood as \textit{structured relations} rather than isolated features. This is especially prominent in music, where tonal structures are organized in the space of pitch and time. For example, concepts such as chords or keys are naturally expressed as structured sets (e.g., the 12 transpositions of a chord or the diatonic system within a key), rather than isolated features. In this study, \textbf{we shift from feature identification to structure-based analysis}, asking whether the learned inner representations of music foundation model emerge as organized structures over features. translated_title: 从孤立特征到轨道：通过多稀疏自编码器对齐发现音乐概念
translated_abstract: 我们如何理解音乐基础模型*内部*学到了什么？大多数可解释性方法，如探测和稀疏自编码器（SAE），专注于在最小结构假设下识别单个特征。我们认为许多概念更适合理解为*结构化关系*而非孤立特征。这在音乐中尤为突出，因为调性结构是在音高和时间的空间中组织起来的。例如，和弦或调等概念自然地表现为结构化集合（例如，一个和弦的12个移位或一个调内的自然音系统），而非孤立特征。在这项研究中，**我们将焦点从特征识别转向基于结构的分析**，探究音乐基础模型学到的内部表征是否以特征之上的有组织结构形式涌现。为此，我们引入了一个使用音高移位作为……的框架
tldr: 该论文提出将音乐模型可解释性研究从识别孤立特征转向分析结构化关系，通过多稀疏自编码器（SAE）对齐框架，利用音高移位来发现音乐基础模型内部表征中以轨道形式组织的音乐概念（如和弦的12个移位集合）。
en_tdlr: This paper shifts interpretability research from isolated feature identification to structure-based analysis, introducing a multi-SAE alignment framework that uses pitch transposition to discover organized musical concepts (such as chord transposition orbits) in music foundation model representations.
